items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Warren Smith and Georgie and all of them all the top jazz men in that territory around Chicago would always come out to Paul's and they'd all jam

ctx.x: I heard him play one night up there when he had the barbecue on Monday nights seems that everybody has these sessions Monday nights on his barbecue place up on State Street did you ever see that

oh yeah I was there in fact in 36 I believe it was I was up there when Paul used to have he had the P&M then at that time that's the one where I went well he had all the jam sessions of course the Bobcats were there Eddie Miller Bob Zerkey and he used to have Baby Dodds because Baby Dodds was his favorite drummer and he used to send for Lee Collins all the time and Warren Smith and Georgie and all of them all the top jazz men in that territory around Chicago would always come out to Paul's and they'd all jam and…

he was a very wonderful fellow I only knew him a couple of nights you might say we were working on the book Jazzman I went there to interview him in 1938 I remember one Monday session maybe more than one at that time he didn't seem to be playing regularly I mean he had this little restaurant so he must have given up music professionally
